title: Two-Band Lipid CH2 Cubic Hopfield Interlacing, Middle-Polariton Suppression, and 1/N Anharmonic 2D-IR Discriminators for 71-THz Mito-Polaritons
abstract: Real inner-mitochondrial-membrane phospholipid bilayers exhibit a resolved two-band methylene (CH2) stretching doublet at 85.4 THz (symmetric) and 87.5 THz (antisymmetric) rather than a single 87-THz oscillator. Continuing ARR-2025-2AQXS44H6Z8GQAG2, ARR-2026-1E91AXEJYT890TQC, and Wave M1 on the unrefereed preprint by Yang, Gu, and Song (bioRxiv:10.64898/2026.09.10.750628v1, Sep. 2026, awaiting independent replication), we establish the gauge-invariant two-band cubic Hopfield theory backed by MITO-TWOBAND-CUBIC-HOPFIELD-CERT-1.0 (20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 grind, 0 Classical.choice; AST-audited zero-float Python verifier; 16 SHA-256 certificates C01-C16; 57 adversarial tests). We prove: (i) exact TRK cancellation P3(0) = -wc^2 w1^2 w2^2 < 0 and global stability on (-infty, 0]; (ii) strict Cauchy-Hopfield root interlacing mandating a trapped Middle Polariton (MP^0) inside (85.4, 87.5) THz across all detunings; (iii) a calculus-free proof of strict two-band ZPE positivity (Delta nu_ZPE = 3.6153 THz in C01); (iv) a universal analytic ceiling proving >100x USC suppression of MP^0 photonic weight (0.33% in C01 vs 35.5% in C05); (v) a >5.8e6x 1/N 2D-IR Kerr anharmonicity discriminator separating collective polaritons (N=10^6) from local artifacts (N=1); and (vi) LP polaron protection (eta_leak <= 1/576) vs MP^0 fluid-bilayer mixing (16/49), paired with CH2->CD2 lipid deuteration shifting LP/MP^0 to 58.36/64.24 THz, >10 THz clear of the 75-THz D2O O-D band.
